title: MultiSearchOutput
description: Multi-query JSON envelope emitted by `duckduckgo-search-cli` when multiple queries are passed. v0.9.8 agent-ready defaults: default `--vertical all`, content fetch ON (opt-out `--no-fetch-content`). Each `searches[]` item is a full SearchOutput ($ref search-output.schema.json) and may carry agent chrome metadata on `metadata` (`chrome_path_resolved`, `chrome_channel`, honest `used_chrome`) — not telemetry. Wire keys: English default (v1.0.2 / ADR-0027); PT aliases accepted on deserialize.

query_count.description: Number of queries in this batch.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the batch start.

parallelism.description: Maximum concurrent queries executed (--parallel value). v1.0.3: renamed from the stale Portuguese spelling `paralelismo`. The English wire (ADR-0027) always emitted `parallelism`, yet `paralelismo` was listed as required — so under additionalProperties: false every multi-query envelope was rejected twice over.

searches.description: Per-query SearchOutput envelopes, in execution order. v0.9.8: default vertical is `all` (web+news); content fetch ON unless `--no-fetch-content`. v0.8.9+ (GAP-WS-105): with --vertical news|all each item may carry optional news fields (news[], quantidade_news, metadata.vertical_usada) — one Chrome session per query. Because items $ref search-output.schema.json, each inherits SearchMetadata agent fields `chrome_path_resolved` / `chrome_channel` / `used_chrome` (not telemetry).

zero_cause_histogram.description: v0.8.0+: Histogram of `zero_cause` values across all queries in this batch. Keys are kebab-case cause names; values are occurrence counts. BTreeMap iteration order (lexicographic) ensures deterministic output. v1.0.3: renamed from `causa_zero_histogram`. Unlike the other ADR-0027 leftovers, this one was Portuguese in the *code* as well, so the English default wire really did emit a Portuguese key; `--wire-keys pt` still emits `causa_zero_histogram`, and the serde alias keeps pre-1.0.3 documents readable.
